اعتكدتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَكَدْتُنَّ (iʕtakadtunna) /iʕ.ta.kad.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# اُعْتُكِدْتُنَّ (uʕtukidtunna) /uʕ.tu.kid.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
